issues.description: mathimpl.py uses sys.version_info without importing sys
issues.detail: In numba/cpython/mathimpl.py and numba/np/math/mathimpl.py, the new code references `sys.version_info` but the diff shows no `import sys` added to either file. If `sys` is not already imported in these modules, this will raise NameError at import time on every Python version, breaking the entire module. Must verify and add the import if missing.

issues.description: Conditional infer_global registration in mathdecl.py loses indentation context and is fragile
issues.detail: The patch dedents and adds `if sys.version_info >= (3, 11): Math_unary = infer_global(math.exp2)(Math_unary)` immediately after the class body. The blank line separating class from following code was removed, and reassigning `Math_unary` via the decorator return value is non-obvious. A cleaner pattern is `@infer_global(math.exp2)` style or a dedicated registration block; current code is hard to read and easy to break.

issues.description: Python 3.11 gating is unnecessary; numba already requires Python >= 3.10 and likely higher
issues.detail: Numba's current main branch supported Python versions almost certainly exceed 3.10 (3.11+ is typical for active development). The `if sys.version_info >= (3, 11)` guards add complexity that may be dead code. Check numba's minimum supported Python; if it's already >= 3.11, drop the guards entirely and simplify all three sites plus the test skip.

issues.description: Test x_values list has duplicate -2 and 2, and mixes ints with floats unsafely
issues.detail: `x_values = [-2, -1, -2, 2, 1, 2, .1, .2]` has duplicate entries (-2 and 2 appear twice) — looks copy-pasted from test_exp. Also `.1` and `.2` will be cast to int types like uint64, producing 0 and losing test signal for fractional inputs across integer types. Consider distinct values and type-appropriate samples.

issues.description: Release note file missing trailing newline
issues.detail: `docs/upcoming_changes/10276.new_feature.rst` ends with `\ No newline at end of file`. Numba's release-note tooling and POSIX text-file conventions expect a trailing newline; add one to avoid concatenation issues when towncrier (or similar) assembles the changelog.

issues.description: Negative integer inputs to exp2 return huge but well-defined values; no edge cases for inf/nan tested
issues.detail: `run_unary` likely compares against CPython math.exp2; that's fine. But the test omits coverage for special values (inf, -inf, nan) that other math tests typically include, and for very large positive integers where overflow behavior may differ between LLVM intrinsic and CPython. Worth at least one explicit special-value assertion.

review.summary: The PR adds `math.exp2` support in a straightforward way, mirroring the existing `math.exp` implementation across typing, CPU impl, NumPy impl, docs, and tests. The biggest concern is that `sys.version_info` is referenced in `numba/cpython/mathimpl.py` and `numba/np/math/mathimpl.py` without a visible `import sys` in the diff — if those modules don't already import sys, this is a P0 import-time crash. The Python 3.11 gating is also likely unnecessary given numba's minimum Python version. Test inputs were copy-pasted from `test_exp` and contain duplicates plus fractional values that degrade to 0 on integer types.
